record_type_quote: We ran a replication of study 2A from this paper, which tested whether knowing additional information about another person changed what participants thought the other person would know about them.

targets.title: Knowledge about others reduces one’s own sense of anonymity.
targets.evidence_quote: We ran a replication of Study 2A from: Shah, A.K., & LaForest, M. (2022). Knowledge about others reduces one’s own sense of anonymity.
targets.outcome_quote: Our replication study (N = 475) examined whether people assigned a higher probability to the chance of another person detecting their lie if they were given information about that other person than if they were not. We found that the main result from the original study did not hold in our replication.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly judge the central effect to have failed. Successful manipulation check does not change that verdict.
